notes: Wargrid, a playable Godot 4.7 isometric RTS (skirmish vs bot and online 1v1) with a browser/desktop build. Graphics are placeholder shapes drawn in code. Music is CC-BY (Alexandr Zhelanov, congusbongus, Kevin MacLeod); SFX/voices are Wargrid-made. Three maps are converted from Electronic Arts GPL-3.0 Zero Hour map sources with EA additional terms in game/data/maps/NOTICE.md. No bundled fonts, no addons, no Git LFS. Not affiliated with EA; Command & Conquer is named only as design inspiration.
